subject: Remote screening sample transfer & training attestation for SIG/CAIQ
body:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@sigpartner.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Brightline Audit Team <soc2-audit@brightline.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Personnel sampling and training attestation request (SIG/CAIQ)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG/CAIQ mapping review, the auditor team is asking for a small, randomized sample of personnel screening and training artifacts focusing on hires and leavers from Apr–Jun 2026. Specifically we need:

- A manifest of the sample records (employee id, hire date, termination date if applicable, role, redaction flag)
- Redacted background check confirmations or summary statements (names redacted)
- Proof of annual security awareness training completion (signed attestation PDFs are fine)
- Evidence that account provisioning/deprovisioning actions were taken within the documented SLA (logs or snapshots)

We prefer a CSV/TSV manifest and PDFs for attestation. Redactions are acceptable — please note the redaction method and what was removed. For traceability please include a short mapping doc or comment on selection method (random seed or selection criteria).

Target turnaround: EOD Thu, Aug 27. If you anticipate delay, flag now and propose alternate date. Also let us know if you want to share via secure Drive link or file transfer.

Regards,
Elaine Park
SIG Partner – Compliance Services
Elaine Park | sigpartner.com

---

On Fri, 21 Aug 2026 at 09:34 -0700, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@sigpartner.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Personnel sampling and training attestation request (SIG/CAIQ)

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear ask. Quick clarifying questions before we assemble: 

1) Sample size: would a random sample of 30 employees (mix of hires and leavers across the window) work, or do you need a percentage-based sample?
2) Redaction guidance: we typically replace PII with <REDACTED> and keep unique employee IDs for traceability. Is that acceptable for your auditors?
3) Delivery method: we can put items in a restricted Drive folder and share a link, or deliver via the secure SFTP you used last quarter. Which do you prefer?

I’ve looped in Marissa (HR) and Ben (Security) to pull manifests and attestations. We’ll prepare a short selection-method note and the manifest as CSV. Expect a preliminary pack by EOD Tue, Aug 24 and final by Thu the 27th unless your sample size needs to be larger.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee | Security Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

---

On Fri, 21 Aug 2026 at 10:21 -0700, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@sigpartner.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Personnel sampling and training attestation request (SIG/CAIQ)

Thanks Soojin — I can take point on the manifest and the attestation PDFs. Plan:

- Generate sample using deterministic seed (sha256 of "Brightline-Aug2026-v1") then select first 30 records; include 8 leavers and 22 hires to reflect population.
- Produce screening_manifest.csv (columns: employee_id, hire_date, termination_date, role, sample_flag, redaction_flag).
- Pull training completion records and create training_attestation_redacted.pdf (each page: employee id, course version, completion date, trainer signature redacted).
- Export account provisioning snapshots for the sampled employees (onboard_sample_metadata.tsv).

I’m attaching the manifest draft and a short selection note. We will redact names and full DOBs — keeping month/year where helpful for timeline verification. We will deliver via a restricted Drive folder and provide auditor access.

Attachments: screening_manifest.csv (draft), onboarding_selection_note.txt

Marissa Cole
Head of People Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

---

On Fri, 21 Aug 2026 at 12:47 -0700, Elaine Park <elaine.park@sigpartner.com> wrote:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@sigpartner.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Brightline Audit Team <soc2-audit@brightline.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 12:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Personnel sampling and training attestation request (SIG/CAIQ)

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear plan. A couple quick asks before you finalize: 

- Please include a short redaction log (what fields were redacted and redaction token used).
- For the training attestation PDFs, we need a single page per sample with a signature line (electronic signature is okay) and a note saying "redacted for PII" where applicable.
- Can the Drive folder be set to expire access in 90 days? If your platform can’t enforce expiry, please note retention period in the delivery note.

Also, would it be possible to have a 30-min check-in early next week (Mon/Tue) so the audit team can ask quick follow-ups after review? Proposed windows: Mon Aug 24 10:00–12:00 PDT or Tue Aug 25 14:00–16:00 PDT.

If all good we will expect the draft manifest by Tue EOD and final PDFs by Thu EOD.

Best,
Elaine
SIG Partner – Compliance Services

---

[Attachment stubs referenced in thread]
- screening_manifest.csv (draft) — CSV, 30 rows, columns: employee_id,hire_date,termination_date,role,sample_flag,redaction_flag
- training_attestation_redacted.pdf — PDF, 30 pages (one per sample), names replaced with <REDACTED>, electronic signature present
- onboard_sample_metadata.tsv — TSV, provisioning snapshot exports (user_id, created_at, removed_at, provision_source)

[Delivery plan]
- Files to be uploaded to a restricted Google Drive folder.
- Access: Elaine Park (elaine.park@sigpartner.com) and soc2-audit@brightline.com.
- Retention: Redwood will keep files in restricted folder for 90 days, then remove; audit notes will be saved in HubSpot HS-5821.

Action items:
- Marissa: upload draft manifest & selection note to Drive by Tue Aug 24 EOD.
- Ben: prepare provisioning snapshots and confirm log excerpts available for export.
- Soojin: schedule 30-min check-in (choose Mon 08/24 10:00 PDT or Tue 08/25 14:00 PDT) and share calendar invite with auditor.
